title: Constructibility is local on a retrocompact open
statement: Let X be a topological space with a basis consisting of quasi-compact open subsets. Let E be constructible in X and let F be a subset of E that is constructible in the subspace E [def-weil-constructible-subset]. Then F is constructible in X (Topology Tag `09YJ`).

source.place: Topology, Lemma Tag 09YJ (Lemma 5.15.12, constructible subsets local on a space with a quasi-compact-open basis)

mathlib_searches.query: a constructible subset of a retrocompact open subset is constructible in the ambient topological space
mathlib_searches.results: Mathlib has Boolean-algebra and retrocompact-set primitives but no theorem for constructibility local on a retrocompact open subspace.

mathlib_searches.query: IsConstructible E in an open retrocompact subset implies IsConstructible E in X
mathlib_searches.results: No declaration combines IsConstructible with an ambient retrocompact-open inclusion; only Boolean closure operations are available.
The source contains IsRetrocompact and IsConstructible Boolean-subalgebra ingredients, but no locality theorem for an open retrocompact subspace.
